public RdKafka\QueueRdKafka\KafkaConsumer::getConsumerQueue
Returns the queue that RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::consume serves: messages from partitions that are not split, and rebalance, offset commit, error and other callback events.
Each call returns the same RdKafka\Queue object while it is in use. The queue keeps the consumer alive, and is invalidated by RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close or the consumer's destruction; an asynchronous close finishing does not invalidate it.
Use it to inspect the number of waiting events with RdKafka\Queue::getLength, or to be notified about new events with RdKafka\Queue::ioEventEnable. Keep serving the queue with RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::consume within max.poll.interval.ms.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws RdKafka\Exception when called from a callback while RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close is running.
